events.evidence: Tajikistan President Emomali Rahmon orders the mobilization of 20,000 military reservists to secure the border with Afghanistan in response to recent Taliban advances
A government warehouse near Karaj, Iran, catches fire after an explosion, where an attack recently occurred targeting a nuclear facility
Indonesia reports a record for the second consecutive day of 31,189 new cases and a record for the third consecutive day of 728 deaths

label.note: Afghanistan border mobilization, Iran explosion near nuclear facility and record Asian COVID cases are risk-off.
